messages:
maria: alert: spike in 5xx+latency for model variant `theta-v4-experimental` in us-west-2. seen across multiple routes, latency > 2s p95 and error rate 6% -> dashboard https://redwood.internal/dash/xyz
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • P1 • "theta-v4-experimental degraded" • zoom: https://zoom.link/abc • runbook: https://confluence/internal/incidents/theta-deg
kyle-oncall: ack @maria, i'm jumping in. handing paging -> @sre-lead for mitigation advice. anyone seeing config drift?
sre-lead: seen similar yesterday on a different quantized build. immediate mitigations: 1) stop routing new requests to theta-v4-experimental (park variant), 2) reroute to stable `theta-v3-stable`, 3) slice heavy API keys & apply emergency per-key rate limits, 4) monitor for regressions. Do that in that order.
eng-ml: adding context: theta-v4-experimental was auto-rolled from model-import pipeline; we've seen degraded KV cache hit rates and OOM-ish traces. safe to stop routing — stateful sessions will fallback to stable variant.
ops-bot: suggested command sequence:
```
# park variant (stop routing)
redwood route update --variant theta-v4-experimental --state parked
# promote stable fanout
redwood route update --route /api/generate --variant theta-v3-stable --weight 100
# emergency key slice (reduce top keys)
redwood quotas set --key-prefix customer:heavy --rate 200/s
```
maria: executing first command now, will confirm when queued.
deploy-bot: Execute: `redwood route update --variant theta-v4-experimental --state parked` queued by maria @ 09:12 UTC. CI checks passed.
maria: command returned 200 OK. routing change applied -> theta-v4-experimental marked PARKED :white_check_mark:
kyle-oncall: good. now running fanout to stable at 100%.
maria: ran `redwood route update --route /api/generate --variant theta-v3-stable --weight 100` -> 200 OK. traffic should be draining from experimental.
eng-ml: note — long-running sessions referencing KV cache on theta-v4 may see slight truncation; we should set short-lived fallback header to avoid bad completions.
sre-lead: applying emergency quota slice for top 50 keys. command:
```
redwood quotas bulk-set --selector "usage>10000/day" --rate 150/s --reason "incident 2526000000 emergency slice"
```
ops-bot: quotas change applied. listing top changed keys:
- customer:acme-corp -> 150/s
- customer:shopherald -> 150/s
- customer:dev-sandbox -> 150/s
... (total 47 keys)
alex-cs: notifying customers now. message template: "We're routing your requests to a stable model variant due to elevated errors; you may see transient latency differences. Our team is working on a fix."
alex-cs: pinged top impacted customers (acme, shopherald, beta-co). CS ticket IDs: CS-3421, CS-3422, CS-3423.
metrics-bot: 09:17 UTC • error rate for /api/generate dropped from 6.1% -> 0.9% within 3 minutes of fanout. p95 latency reduced from 2.3s -> 1.1s.
kyle-oncall: monitoring. good signal. can we confirm no downstream API schema mismatches? eng-ml?
eng-ml: verified sample outputs from theta-v3-stable in us-west-2 — different tokenization at edges but within expected diff. I'll queue canary tests against saved prompt-sets.
sre-lead: also re-enabled additional observability hooks: capture a handful of problematic traces and store for postmortem. command:
```
redwood trace enable --filter "variant:theta-v4-experimental" --sample 100
```
ops-bot: trace sampling enabled. storing to s3://redwood-incidents/2526000000/traces
kyle-oncall: quick risk check: any customers pinned to theta-v4-experimental specifically?
alex-cs: none on strict pinning; a couple requested previews but not pinned — we already notified them.
maria: follow-up: internal alerting rules temporarily suppressed to avoid alert storms for the same symptom. `alerts mute incident=2526000000`.
incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE • P1 -> active mitigations in place. owner: kyle-oncall • bridge open • runbook progress: park -> fanout -> quotas -> notify -> monitoring
eng-ml: proposed next step: revert the auto-rolled build in the import pipeline; retain build artifacts for debug. I can run a rollback job if approved.
sre-lead: approve rollback of pipeline; do NOT reintroduce theta-v4-experimental until root cause identified. eng-ml, please create a safe tag and block auto-promote.
eng-ml: running rollback job now:
```
modelctl revert --model theta --from-tag v3-stable --to-tag v3-stable-20260315
modelctl block-autopromote --model theta --variant theta-v4-experimental
```
eng-ml: rollback completed, autopromote blocked.
maria: systems look stable. error spikes subsided, infra mem/CPU normal.
kyle-oncall: handing to oncall-secondary @sre-lead for 2hr watch, i'll stage a postmortem writeup template. if anything regresses ping here.
sre-lead: taking handoff. will remain on the bridge. @eng-ml, please upload logs/traces to the incident folder and attach to the ticket.
eng-ml: uploaded logs + core dumps to s3://redwood-incidents/2526000000 and added links to Jira: INC-2526000000
alex-cs: updating affected customers with rollback + mitigation summary. will add expected ETA for full fix: 48 hours.
kyle-oncall: thanks team. follow-up actions added: 1) add pre-merge smoke tests for kv-cache health, 2) tune auto-promote gating, 3) add alert for low KV hit-rate before errors, 4) postmortem + RCA assigned to @eng-ml and @sre-lead.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED • state: mitigated -> monitoring • next step: postmortem
maria: closing bridge in 30m unless new alerts. good job everyone :tada:
sre-lead: noted. will consolidate timeline and publish interim incident summary in #incidents and to execs.
alex-cs: final note — CS will offer impacted customers 30k free tokens and a dedicated follow-up call. sending out now.
